verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly publish official SDKs for its data or filing APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt probes that returned HTTP 403, and neither shows any official SDK, so the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the 403 walls blocked inspection rather than showing that no SDK exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
